flow.merge_rate_per_hour.basis: units.json + units-archive.json merged/landed events per UTC day 2026-11-02..08: 40, 45, 34, 33, 33, 52, 60; best 2.50/h, median 1.67/h; the old 6.5/h target was never reached in that window

delivery.merged_not_live.basis: merge-rate standard 3/h x release-interval standard (healthy 2 h, unhealthy 4 h); the old 0/1 bound went red after any merge mid-cycle (2026-11-09)

gh_budget.graphql_used_per_hour.basis: GitHub rate_limit resources.graphql.used sampled once per minute; the healthy target is the factory budget and 2,500 is the alert line

gh_budget.rest_used_per_hour.basis: GitHub rate_limit resources.core.used sampled once per minute; the healthy target is counted REST and 3,500 is the alert line

delivery.proof_browser_lock_wait_p50_ms.basis: Rolling 24 h completed proof lease samples; fewer than 20 remains LOW-N

delivery.proof_browser_lock_wait_p90_ms.basis: Rolling 24 h completed proof lease samples; fewer than 20 remains LOW-N

delivery.proof_browser_wait_over_review_.basis: Share above 1,000 ms in rolling 24 h completed proof lease samples; minimum 20
